mapper.sql: SELECT p.bsn_part_id,p.bsn_part_nm,p.hq_yn,p.use_yn,p.sort_seq, s.ldr_nm,s.prft_dstrb_rt,s.bsn_fee_amt,s.aply_bgn_ym, (SELECT count(*) FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt > #{today})) AS "peopleCount", (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.prj j WHERE j.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND j.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "projectCount" FROM mst.bsn_part p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.ldr_nm,h.prft_dstrb_rt,h.bsn_fee_amt,h.aply_bgn_ym FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist h WHERE h.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND (h.aply_end_ym IS NULL OR h.aply_end_ym >= #{month}) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1 ) s ON true
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () rows ORDER BY ${order} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT part_std_hist_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt, CASE WHEN aply_bgn_ym > #{month} THEN '예정' WHEN aply_end_ym IS NULL OR aply_end_ym >= #{month} THEN '적용 중' ELSE '지난 기준' END AS status FROM mst.bsn_part_std_hist WHERE bsn_part_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC
SELECT max(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE bsn_part_nm=#{name})
INSERT INTO mst.bsn_part(bsn_part_nm,hq_yn,sort_seq,use_yn,created_by) SELECT #{input.bsn_part_nm},'N',COALESCE(max(sort_seq),0)+1,'Y',#{actor} FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE hq_yn='N' RETURNING bsn_part_id

INSERT INTO mst.bsn_part_std_hist(bsn_part_id,aply_bgn_ym,aply_end_ym,ldr_user_id,ldr_nm,prft_dstrb_rt,bsn_fee_amt,created_by) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{input.aply_bgn_ym},NULL,NULL,#{input.ldr_nm},#{input.prft_dstrb_rt},#{input.bsn_fee_amt},#{actor}) RETURNING part_std_hist_id
